items.evidence_summary: The official careers page states that all listed positions accept applications today and exposes two remote freelance roles. The Front-End Developer role is project-based, integrates CMSs including WordPress, values performance/WCAG and ongoing month-after-month availability, and offers a long-term relationship after a short paid test. The web design/maquetación role is freelance remote per project, requires strong HTML/CSS/Figma, values JavaScript, WordPress, accessibility and performance, and explicitly states that good work can lead to a constant flow of assignments.
items.why_high_value: Near-direct VDS fit with explicit current freelance demand, remote Spain compatibility, WordPress/frontend/performance/accessibility overlap and unusually strong recurring-work language from an agency building external production capacity.
verified_facts: Official careers page says the listed roles accept applications today.
Two relevant roles are explicitly freelance and remote.
Frontend work includes CMS integration including WordPress and values performance/WCAG.
Frontend role mentions ongoing availability month after month and a long-term relationship after a paid test.
Web design/maquetación requires HTML/CSS/Figma and values WordPress, accessibility and performance.
Web design/maquetación explicitly states a constant flow of assignments may follow good work.
Official company location is Castellón, Spain.
inferences: The web design/maquetación role is the safest truthful fit for VDS; the Front-End role additionally mentions React or Astro and should not be used to imply unsupported framework depth.
Exact monthly assignment volume is not guaranteed.
safe_alternative_angles: Apply manually to the web design/maquetación freelance role emphasizing HTML/CSS, responsive implementation, WordPress, performance, accessibility and conversion of designs into production pages.

Consider the Front-End freelance role only if every mandatory framework requirement can be met truthfully; emphasize transferable CMS/WordPress/performance strengths without overstating React/Astro experience.
do_not_bypass_constraints: Do not substitute a generic company email for the role-specific official application forms.
Do not upload a CV unless the exact file is owner-approved under the attachment safety protocol.
Do not claim React/Astro depth that is not supported by the verified VDS profile.
Do not claim application submitted unless the manual form is actually completed.
recommended_human_checks: Prioritize the web design/maquetación role as the cleaner truthful fit.
Confirm the application form remains open immediately before submission.
Verify any CV upload against governance/approved-attachments.json before use.
Select portfolio examples showing WordPress, responsive implementation, performance and polished design execution.
